name: Igarashi Jun
source:
She is the girlfriend of Yuuji.
[spoiler]She lost her virginity with him while [url=https://vndb.org/c45579]Riri[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c45577]Akira[/url] was peeping at them.

Strangely, she doesn't fall under the influence of the virus and doesn't seem to be infected once she is raped by the infected, she may carry inside her an immunizing gene.[/spoiler]
